recommendation.format: WebP90 for LOCAL playback on the measured Mac; JPEG90 optional alternative
recommendation.reason: Smallest footprint with similar measured fps. JPEG has lower event-viewer decode-promise wait; these are not isolated decoder CPU benchmarks.
recommendation.limits: one full-duration trial per format/speed/case, quality settings not perceptually equated; PNG remains the source of inference and original evidence; no product integration
